description: This file defines custom exception classes for handling missing partitions and partitions in Apache Spark SQL Catalyst analysis module. It includes classes NoSuchPartitionException and NoSuchPartitionsException, with constructors for various use cases, and references external Spark components.

classes.name: NoSuchPartitionException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating a specific partition was not found in a table, with constructors for different contexts including database, table, and partition specifications.

classes.name: NoSuchPartitionsException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating multiple partitions were not found, with constructors for database, table, and list of partition specifications.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Various constructors for NoSuchPartitionException and NoSuchPartitionsException, initializing with error class, message parameters, or specific partition details.
